newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police hold German, Austrian on murder charge.
newsitem.headline: Thai police hold German, Austrian on murder charge.

text.p: Thai police said on Wednesday they had detained a German and an Austrian on suspicion of robbing and murdering a German male last December.
They said Peter Bernert, 37, of Berlin, and Thomas Bauhofer, 28, of Austria, were detained on Monday at the Thai beach resort of Pattaya southeast of Bangkok.

Police said the two men confessed during questioning that together with two other foreign accomplices still at large, they had spiked with a sleeping draught a beer given to their victim, Guido Raffenberg, at a hotel bar in Pattaya on December 27.

The men later traveled by car to a golf course where, according to police, Bauhofer hit his victim with a spade. They later decapitated Raffenberg and dumped the head in a field about 20 km (12 miles) from the scene.
Police said they found Raffenberg's body on January 8. They said the dead man, 28, was from Werde in Germany.
It was not immediately known when Bernert and Bauhofer would be charged in court.
